# Confirm expired edited drafts leave saved entries unchanged

## What & Why
The recovery deadline test confirms that an edited draft expires and announces its loss, but it does not explicitly verify that the original saved entry remains intact after the draft is discarded by expiry.

## Done looks like
- An edited answer draft expires without replacing or deleting the saved answer.
- An edited opportunity draft expires without replacing or deleting the saved opportunity.
- Reloading both lists still shows the original saved values.
